svg.title: Policy performance in simulation and the real world
svg.desc: RoboCasa-GR1 / GR00T N1.7: MSE-Policy 35.55%, Flow-Policy 42.34%, HT-Policy 50.01%; SimplerEnv / GR00T N1.7: MSE-Policy 59.555%, Flow-Policy 64.945%, HT-Policy 63.78%; LIBERO / π₀.₅: MSE-Policy 96.72%, Flow-Policy 97.09%, HT-Policy 96.97%; LIBERO-10 / Cosmos 3: MSE-Policy 95.10%, Flow-Policy 95.60%, HT-Policy 96.50%; RoboMimic: MSE-Policy 82.15%, Diffusion Policy 94.08333333333333333333333335%, HT-Policy 93.6111111111111111111111111%; Push-T: MSE-Policy 54%, Flow-Policy 86%, HT-Policy 88%; Peel-Note: MSE-Policy 22%, Flow-Policy 56%, HT-Policy 52%; Insert-T: MSE-Policy 86%, Flow-Policy 92%, HT-Policy 92%. SimplerEnv is the unweighted mean of Bridge and Fractal. LIBERO with pi0.5 is the four-suite average. RoboMimic averages best-checkpoint success over state/image observations and U-Net/Transformer backbones, following the paper teaser.
